prompts.portrait: Prepare ONE isolated transparent PIXEL RPG portrait of EXACT COGLET in the TWO most recent owner concept/movement images. Preserve small toy-like round cream/off-white domed mechanical body with brass/brown casing bands, FOUR short dark charcoal jointed legs with brass wedge feet, TWO large circular CYAN luminous front lenses in near-black gray rims, and ONE LARGE BRASS DORSAL COG attached atop/back of shell on central axle. Gear about half body diameter, simple chunky teeth with cyan/gray central bearing, consistent shape; not flower/ears/crown. Curious friendly mechanical beetle-like machine, not organic animal. Three-quarter front facing LEFT, all four complete legs readable, huge dorsal gear fully visible. Exact owner proportions/colors, simple crisp pixel clusters/dark outline with minimal small detail, readable at 37/115px. Whole body centered with enormous transparent margins, no clipping. No concept board, text, labels, shadows, checkerboard, scenery, extra creatures, floating particles, wires, weapons or additional props. TRUE alpha transparency, one complete creature only.
prompts.combat: Create ONE transparent production battle atlas of EXACT attached COGLET machine, adapting its orientation to LEFT-facing three-quarter battle view. Small round cream/brass shell with TWO cyan front circular lenses in dark rims, FOUR short charcoal jointed legs/brass wedge feet, LARGE brass DORSAL COG with cyan central bearing and same chunky tooth pattern. Preserve exact toy-like mechanical design, crisp pixel RPG style, no organic creature parts. Strict FOUR equal columns by FIVE equal rows, twenty complete figures at same body scale. Make EVERY whole figure INCLUDING gear and legs at most 55% equal cell width and 60% equal cell height, centered with very wide transparent margins on ALL sides. ROW1 IDLE: planted legs, tiny shell lift, cyan lens blink/dim, settle; gear turns slightly. ROW2 ATTACK: brace all legs and lean shell forward, winding cog, short leftward mechanical lunge, return stance; no beam drawn (runtime supplies Spark effect). ROW3 HIT: tilt shell backwards, splayed recovery legs, brace low, regain planted stance. ROW4 FAINT: lenses dim, legs crouch, shell rests low with complete gear, powered-down calm. ROW5 CAPTURE REACTION: lenses widen/brighten, curious tilt, legs tuck cooperatively, calm friendly stance. Keep gear visible and same round casing/lens layout in EVERY frame. No orbs, bubbles, symbols, stars, sparks, detached particles, external trails or drawn shadows. Entire anatomy isolated INSIDE own equal cell, no neighboring parts, no clipped gear/feet. No text, labels, background, checkerboard or grid. TRUE transparent alpha.
prompts.follower: Create ONE true transparent isometric movement atlas of EXACT attached COGLET. Small round toy machine: cream/brass domed casing, FOUR short dark charcoal articulated legs with brass tips, TWO circular cyan luminous FRONT lenses with black-gray rims, ONE LARGE brass dorsal COG attached to shell, same chunky tooth count/design and cyan bearing. Keep all components and gear visible from every angle; crisp simple pixel-art clusters. Exactly FIVE equal columns by EIGHT equal rows, forty complete isolated figures, same SMALL body scale. Every whole figure gear/legs included at most 55% equal cell WIDTH and 60% equal cell HEIGHT, massive empty alpha gutters on EACH side, fully centered inside own cell. EACH row col1 planted mechanical IDLE four feet steady; col2 left-front/right-rear forward; col3 legs passing; col4 right-front/left-rear forward; col5 alternate passing. Small gear rotation per stride, SAME tooth shape count and diameter, no transformation. Camera elevated 2:1 isometric. ROW1 NORTH straight rear walking AWAY: rear cream/brass casing and axle, NO front cyan eye lenses on back. ROW2 NORTHEAST rear-right three-quarter: mostly rear shell, narrow right lens at far edge, legs up-right. ROW3 EAST right PROFILE: one visible cyan lens aimed RIGHT, gear viewed from rotated side. ROW4 SOUTHEAST front-right three-quarter: both cyan front lenses visible, facing down-right. ROW5 SOUTH symmetric FRONT toward viewer: TWO large cyan lenses side by side, two forefeet, dorsal cog above. ROW6 SOUTHWEST front-left three-quarter: both front lenses, facing down-left. ROW7 WEST left PROFILE: one visible cyan lens aimed LEFT. ROW8 NORTHWEST rear-left three-quarter: mostly rear shell, narrow left lens far edge, facing up-left; clearly DIFFERENT from west profile. All eight genuinely anatomically rotated and readable, north/rear not duplicated south/front. NO text/labels/grid/background/shadows/checkerboard/loose effects or fragments. TRUE RGBA transparent 5x8 equal grid with complete gear/feet, safe broad margins and zero adjacency overlap.
